title: Kira-kun Today
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Awkward, cockatiel-toting high schooler Nino ends up keeping watch over Kira-kun, the class joker and her next-door neighbor, for one year. Kira hides a terrible secret, which database categories describe as a heart condition and imminent death, and the two grow close as she draws him out of his world. Kodansha rates it 13+.
life_message: Love and courage to open up give meaning to time that may be short.
